description: This file defines the SubunitTreeModel class which models hierarchical subunit data, transforming a flat list of Subunit objects into a nested tree structure for API serialization.

classes.name: SubunitTreeModel
classes.description: Models a hierarchical tree of subunits with methods to convert a flat list into nested structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of Subunit objects.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the subunit collection into a nested tree array.

methods.name: toTree
methods.description: Recursively builds a nested tree structure from a flat array of Subunit objects based on their levels.
